release_notes: Build 93 improves Archive completed C so existing Z: copies that were safely rebased after archiving can be reused instead of creating unnecessary archived-copy duplicates.
A reusable existing Z: copy must have the exact same project-folder name and the complete same set of relative file paths as the C: project.

At least 80% of all files, with a minimum of five, must still have identical sizes; this tolerates a small number of Resolve/native metadata files changing size after portable-path rebasing while keeping the identity check strict.
The strong copy identity is verified again immediately before Quiz History is updated and before the C: folder is removed.
If that verification fails, Factburst keeps the C: project and uses the collision-safe new-copy path instead of trusting the existing Z: folder.
Existing Z: folders are still never overwritten or deleted; new archive collisions continue to use archived-copy NNN destinations.
The full desktop test suite includes regression coverage for rebased metadata size changes and rejects archives whose relative file set differs.
Build 92 added Archive completed C, Build 91 added archive/database Diagnostics, and Build 90 added faster cached archive matching.
